posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
Files have been updated. We've got the usual stuff:

  • card boxes, both for penny-sleeved and unsleeved cards
  • environment mats
  • oversized hero and villains
  • card box-sized hp trackers

for all WotC heroes, villains, and environments, plus Guise, Wager Master, and Omnitron-IV, as well as oversized hero cards for the new alts - the Prime Wardens, KNYFE: Rogue Agent, and Argent Adept: Kvothe Sixstrings.

I'm excited to say that Sky-Scraper comes with three different sizes of oversized hero cards - one is about the size of a regular card, one is the normal 4"x6" oversized size, and one is a gigantic 8"x6"-ish.  I love the giant one especially.

I've also updated the quick-reference sheet (the sheet with all the heroes/villains/enviros to help you pick who you want to play) to include the new stuff, and have updated the Search Sheet (the pages you can look through when deciding what card to search for, like if you had an Impromptu Invention) to include Sky-Scraper's equipment cards.

I have not yet updated the Card List as it's getting late, but I'll do that tomorrow.

If you find any problems or errors with the files, please let me know so I can fix them.

So, Spiff accessories are the best. The expanded villain cards, environment backgrounds, all the extra goodies; I love it all.

Except for the HP trackers.

I could never make the double-dial trackers work properly, and the numbers were definitely on the small side for easy viewing across a table. So I designed my own. There's just one generic design for heroes and villains, so you should be able to get by with six or seven dials (the Ennead and the Sentinels being the exceptions, of course). I fastened mine with 3/16" paper eyelets.
